d:
The Suns defeated the Jazz, 111-101 tonight in Utah. Devin Booker contributed a team-high 23 points to go with 3 assists and 2 rebounds, with Dillon Brooks of the Suns adding an additional 18 points (7-14 FG, 2-7 3P) in the game. Darryn Peterson finished with a team-high 20 points along with 10 rebounds for the Jazz in the losing effort. The Suns improve their record to 8-7 with the win, while the Jazz fall to 3-14 for the season.
